svg.desc: NAT Office Complex LOCATION 6th of October, Egypt CLIENT The National Authority for Tunnels (NAT) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2013 500 million EGP DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2013, the 34,000 m2 headquarters for the National Authority for Tunnels (NAT) in 6th of October City reflects the theme of connection, echoing NAT's role in linking Cairo through metro lines. The complex consists of five four-story office buildings connected by elevated bridges, with underground parking. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management.
